title: Seasoning and the Rounding of an Auto Loans Waiver Refund
content:
How the refund owed on waiver coverage financed with a loan of the Auto Loans line is rounded follows how long the loan has been on the books, counted in whole months from the date it funded to the day of the cancellation.

1. Where the loan was funded at least 36 whole months before the cancellation, the refund is rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. Where the loan was funded at least 24 but less than 36 whole months before the cancellation, the refund is rounded half-up to the whole dollar.
3. Where the loan was funded less than 24 whole months before the cancellation, the refund is rounded half-up to the cent.

## The same refund under each convention

Take a refund of 387.85 before rounding. On a loan funded 40 whole months before the cancellation it becomes 387.00. On a loan funded 28 whole months before it becomes 388.00. On a loan funded 12 whole months before it stands at 387.85.

Take a refund of 120.40 instead. At 40 whole months it becomes 120.00; at 28 whole months it becomes 120.00, the cents being below the half; at 12 whole months it stands at 120.40.

## The months at which the conventions change

A loan funded exactly 36 whole months before the cancellation is rounded down to the whole dollar. A loan funded exactly 24 whole months before is rounded half-up to the whole dollar. A loan funded 23 whole months before is rounded half-up to the cent.
